objects.description: Evaluates arithmetic and math-function expressions exactly, so that LLMs don't guess.
objects.docsHtml:
Calculator

Evaluates a math expression exactly, so that the LLM computes rather than guesses.

An expression may use numbers, the operators + - * / ** %, parentheses, the constants pi and e, every function of Python's math module, and abs, round, pow, min and max. It is parsed, not executed: anything else, such as a name or an attribute, is refused.

This extension has no settings.

Tools

calculator(expression)

The value of the expression, e.g. {"result": 11} for 2 + 3 * (4 - 1).

objects.description: Current weather and a 24-hour forecast for any location.
objects.docsHtml:
Weather

Current weather and a 24-hour forecast for any location, from the Open-Meteo api, with locations found by the Google Maps Geocoding api.

Settings

google_maps_api_key

Required. A Google Maps API key with the Geocoding API enabled. See https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/geocoding/get-api-key.

weather_api_url

The Open-Meteo forecast api. Change it only to use a self-hosted Open-Meteo.

Tools

get_weather(location, unit)

The current temperature, precipitation, wind speed and cloud cover, and the forecast for each of the next 24 hours, starting this hour, in metric or US customary units. Times are in the location's own timezone, and the result names the unit of every measurement.
